note: The four retained documents for FCX research stage 1, all SEC EDGAR copies. Retained files live under data/company-sources/fcx/ (ignored by Git, private). Each date is given with the kind of date it is; the filing dates of the 10-Q and of the two Forms 8-K are read from the EDGAR submissions record (fcx-sec-locate-02), and the 10-K's was not read from an EDGAR filing index. approval_id and attempt name the committed acquisition record (acquisition/<approval_id>/outcome-<attempt>.json); folder and name place the retained file under data/company-sources/fcx/. The page server verifies each file against both on every read. The three later documents were first read from investor-relations copies, kept privately and no longer read; every record and passage was matched against the SEC copies (sec-match.md), and sources-private.md (private; not in the public repository) describes the earlier copies.
